title: Broken object-level authorization
validation_oracle: response contains another user's object or PII
remediation: Enforce object ownership or role checks on every object fetch and update path.

title: Unsafe server-side fetch
preconditions: URL parameter reaches server-side request function
validation_oracle: server fetches internal or restricted URL
remediation: Apply strict allowlists, deny internal address ranges, and canonicalize URLs before fetch.

title: Unsafe SQL string construction
validation_oracle: query semantics change or authentication bypass occurs
remediation: Use parameterized queries and server-side input validation.

title: Reflected or stored XSS
preconditions: input reflected into DOM or template output

title: Authentication flow weakness
remediation: Harden session issuance and enforce MFA, rotation, and invalidation.
